name: Network layout
artwork: Original generic physical network device artwork
convention: Original generic physical artwork for cable and rack planning. Each socket is one passive cable endpoint, not an RJ45 contact pinout or a SPICE device. All rack faces are 264 x 24 XML units (1320 x 120 internal units), with the same native bottom-right anchor. SFP+ endpoints represent whole transceiver slots.

sourceReview.decision: Custom physical artwork requested. Existing symbols have perspective/icon geometry and edge terminals; they do not provide the requested socket-centred connections or matching rack envelopes. No donor geometry or pin mappings are used. Manufacturer references inform generic device families, not exact product replicas.

survey.scope: Manufacturer catalogue coverage, not sales or market-share statistics.
survey.naming: Count actual sockets. A five-port PoE switch may have four powered sockets and one uplink. A ten-port switch may mean eight RJ45 plus two SFP, not ten RJ45.
survey.extended: 4 RJ45, 10 RJ45 + 2 SFP+, and 32 RJ45 + 4 SFP+ are generic additional layout options requested for coverage; not claimed to be core manufacturer configurations. 32-port examples in the survey are specialist QSFP/fibre equipment.
